method: Only task-local emulator and bridge were controlled. Before each model switch Suite navigated to about:blank; helper stopped bridge/emulator, started a wiped version with device screenshot saving disabled, loaded the private local QA fixture internally and restarted node-bridge.

Actual UI selected the connected standard-wallet row and acknowledged existing-device recognition where required; no route or store mutation was used to fabricate model-control presence. Redux inspection was restricted to non-secret model/version/capability/boolean metadata.

Model/firmware were independently read from acquired Features; Safe 7 was not attributed until fresh Features and THP properties agreed after pairing. Reused emulator-path remembered states were not treated as fresh Safe 7 evidence.
Settings sections were scrolled individually and every new PNG was inspected locally before its associations were recorded. Only controls visible in those captures were mapped.
Model One and Model T PIN setup were canceled with no PIN entered. Backup-check remained a dry-run preflight with no words entered.
Safe 7 passphrase protection was temporarily enabled on the disposable fixture to reveal empty forms; no passphrase was typed and device-entry request was canceled.

Do not label T3B1 emulator evidence as T2B1 testing. Both name Safe 3, but original T2B1 packaging changes default backup and seal guidance. The task helper exposes only T3B1, so T2B1 remains source-derived.

limitations: Only initialized QA device settings and backup-check preflights were exercised. Fresh create/recover onboarding, new-wallet backup defaults, real recovery, backup validation, firmware install, PIN completion and physical display/vibration are not verified by this pass.

All transports here were local USB/node-bridge emulation; physical Bluetooth pairing, NFC backup/media, battery-low or wireless-charging behavior was not exercised. BLE/NFC advertised capability is not a passed hardware test.

Firmware/hardware authenticity protections were bypassed or their known emulator warning dismissed for exploration. Availability of Check device is not successful authentication; initial Model One capture retains the emulator integrity-warning banner.

The isolated QA account sidebar and remembered duplicate Standard wallet instances can survive reuse of the emulator path; they do not prove per-model asset compatibility, independent simultaneous device connections or real balances.

Four originally linked shared recovery-component observations have explicit flow-context errata restricting capture associations to device-settings.check-backup. They must not count as onboarding.recovery.* runtime execution.
Source-derived T2B1 packaging/default differences remain untested; no separate T2B1 emulator was available.
T3T1 evidence is retained from the root audit, not rerun by this agent.
new_feature_review: Existing canonical features cover the reached settings, backup-check, PIN setup and wallet-access entries; model differences add evidence/conditions rather than duplicate user features.

source_evidence.detail: Only T2T1/T3T1 are allowed by explicit rotation gate.
Brightness follows capability; actual observations include Model T and Safe 7.
Haptic toggle follows capability; the anchor mistakenly reuses PinProtection, requiring .first() for the PIN section locator.
Check-device support differs by model; an entry is not proof of genuine hardware.
New-wallet defaults and original Safe 3 packaging remain source-derived in this pass.
Established test-helper semantics used internally for local ephemeral pairing; no raw content or test error text copied.
Pairing digits filled through UI without logging or populated-field capture.
